completion_decisions: The target package is the modified BP/NP evaluator plus exact-gradient WEC-continuation optimizer; unavailable SOWFA is retained as validation evidence, not imitated.
The 2019 paper has no linked source release. Later same-author thomas2021-wec numeric assets and independent FLOWFarm.jl semantics are registered separately from the independent C++ implementation.
The reversed public CP/CT text header is resolved from the source pickle and its conversion script; generator efficiency 0.944 is corroborated by paper Table 2.
The proprietary SNOPT/Tapenade stack is replaced by pinned NLopt SLSQP and project-native fixed-width forward exact AD.
The paper's one baseline plus 199 random starts are reconstructed as deterministic feasible 2D layouts and run through the complete ten-stage WEC/TI lifecycle.
Twenty independent starts are the Waffle full-resource axis; this avoids fine-grained inner oversubscription while consuming all twenty cores.
missing_information: exact author pseudo-random states and 199 initial coordinate arrays
author optimized coordinates and per-stage histories
SOWFA case directories, precursor fields, time histories and execution environment

paper.authors: Jared J. Thomas and Jennifer Annoni and Paul A. Fleming and Andrew Ning
paper.title: Comparison of Wind Farm Layout Optimization Results Using a Simple Wake Model and Gradient-Based Optimization to Large Eddy Simulations

paper_source_conflicts: NREL5MWCPCT_dict.txt reverses the CP/CT labels relative to its source pickle and conversion script.
Eq. 21 prints a 2000 m hub-centre radius; the same-lineage driver uses 1936.8 m so the full rotor remains inside the physical circle.
The twelve public wind probabilities sum to 0.962 and are intentionally not silently renormalized.
The paper requires feasible 2D random starts while a later generator uses one-dimensional rejection spacing.
The paper does not print generator efficiency; the same-lineage driver uses 0.944 and reproduces Table-2 scale.
